scope: Exact/normalized field screening plus source-family author and independent targeted reviews; not a proof of global semantic novelty.
semantic_review: REVIEW_NOTES.md and _catalog/*REVIEW*.md; duplicate scientific obligations discovered during execution must reuse a single owner/evidence, not spawn a renamed copy.
shared_source_policy: Multiple estimands per source; overlapping releases require conditional increments or joint covariance. Source count is not independent dataset count.
review_limit: Completed author reviews plus bounded independent 2026 review and root checks. A requested broader second independent review failed on a worker usage limit; no review is claimed from it.
